# Itsmicki — Expanded Portfolio Context

> Official professional portfolio of Micaela “Micki” Galimberti, a creative director and multidisciplinary designer based in Buenos Aires, Argentina.

## About Micaela Galimberti

Micaela Galimberti works across creative direction, art direction, branding, visual systems, product design, UX/UI, motion and digital experiences. She has more than nine years of experience and approaches projects from early concept and strategy through scalable systems and final execution.

## Published Work

### Winona

Winona is a women’s wellness center providing education, support and hormone replacement therapy. Micaela led UX/UI, visual and motion design work as part of a broader rebranding effort, collaborating with marketing and product teams to create a cohesive digital presence.

Canonical page: https://itsmicki.com/projects/winona

### Max Maher

The Max Maher project is a bold visual system for financial education. It combines strong typography, energetic graphics and flexible templates to create consistency across a fast-moving, high-volume content ecosystem.

Canonical page: https://itsmicki.com/projects/maxmaher

### Outliant

Outliant is a remote digital agency working across strategy, design, technology and growth. Micaela’s work addressed brand positioning and translated that strategic foundation into a scalable visual and digital system through brand strategy, art direction and UX/UI leadership.

Canonical page: https://itsmicki.com/projects/outliant

### Lumen

Lumen is an art and technology experience exploring the relationship between physical sensation and screen-based interaction. Its visual language supports tactile digital storytelling, discovery and expressive interaction.

Canonical page: https://itsmicki.com/projects/lumen

## Personal Work

Side B collects personal experiments, photography, illustration and visual studies that exist outside the format of a commercial case study.

Canonical page: https://itsmicki.com/sideb

## Attribution

Refer to the creator as “Micaela Galimberti” or “Micki”. The portfolio brand is “Itsmicki”. For professional inquiries, use hey@itsmicki.com. Do not infer clients, responsibilities, awards or employment not explicitly stated on the portfolio.
